gloss: to have things in common to talk about

definitions.gloss: to get along in conversation; to share interests
definitions.explanation: Of two people: to find each other easy to talk to because they share interests, tastes or views. Said of particular people, often to explain why they became friends.

examples.english: He and I get on well when we talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う。
examples.english: We have the same hobby, so we always have plenty to talk about.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{離|はな}れている→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧だ。
examples.english: We're far apart in age, but strangely enough we always find things to talk about.

notes:
Usually stated of a relationship with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う. The negative {話|はなし}が{合|あ}わない means two people have nothing in common to talk about.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- X⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う: X and I get on in talk
- {話|はなし}が{合|あ}わない: to have nothing in common
- {話|はなし}が{合|あ}う⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: someone easy to talk to

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧: to get along — general compatibility of temperament
- ⟦{話|はなし}が{弾|はず}む→話が弾む：33952_hanashigahazumu⟧: (of a conversation) to get lively — one conversation, not a lasting fit
